piece.description: Native diagonal two-lane split and reverse merge, with the south paired flat approaches; all directed journeys and their driver-left markings are reversed. Place its owned cells at the matching assembly reference; every native deck retains its measured real car lanes.

engineering.physical_model_function: Native diagonal two-lane split and reverse merge, with the south paired flat approaches; all directed journeys and their driver-left markings are reversed
engineering.path_ownership: Every source route fragment in each owned city cell
engineering.native_phase: Opposite directed native phase, retaining the common axis intersection (8,0) m
engineering.surface_datum_policy: Nominal-height diagonal 57530200 collars and source-measured 57530000 pose 1 roofs; finite transitions retain exact source datums
engineering.graded_top_plane_policy: Pavement and raised barrier tops share the actual unchanged full-width supporting body planes; measured barrier rise is retained
engineering.graded_construction_station_frame: Original canonical physical route IDs and ascending construction order; reverse travel uses the opposite directed ID and length minus station

provenance.geometry: Native-profile DD ends and six source-bound single-lane journeys; physical pavement, closed bodies, barriers, and supporting solids are compiled together before whole-cell ownership.
provenance.construction: Three disjoint functional owners, one native outside socket per owner, and four proper rotations repeated across eight cursor states.
provenance.granularity: Native diagonal two-lane split and reverse merge, with the south paired flat approaches; all directed journeys and their driver-left markings are reversed. Shared decks and route fragments in a city tile retain one coordinated owner; full custom joining boundaries are supplied by checked connector exports.
